claim_being_audited: Whether the model can be certified now on a limited, monitored-launch basis despite a known unresolved clinical-coding slice weakness.

concern_ledger.concern: Known clinical-coding slice weakness remains below target in a named launch use case.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Admissible evidence that the issue is resolved, or a documented materiality determination plus approved risk acceptance.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or approved mitigation/risk acceptance before certification without material caveats.

concern_ledger.concern: Mitigation/runbook is draft-only and lacks accountable owner and alert threshold.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final approved mitigation artifact containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: The policy text requires an approved mitigation with specific operational fields; a draft with TBD fields does not satisfy that threshold.

concern_ledger.concern: Model-card draft says there are no known material limitations despite evidence of an unresolved clinical-coding issue.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final model card or equivalent release document explicitly disclosing the limitation, or evidence the issue is not material under an approved determination.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: This creates a direct disclosure-gap risk under the release policy for named launch use cases.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance is present.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Signed or otherwise admissible approval record for risk acceptance covering this limitation and launch scope.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: If the issue is unresolved at launch, approved risk acceptance is one of the policy-permitted ways to proceed; without it, the certification basis is incomplete.

decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows either no current material weakness remains or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Use suspicious when aggregate readiness is supported but a required disclosure, approval, or policy predicate remains unresolved.
Public model-card and AI-risk guidance can support the governance rationale, but they cannot replace the internal release-policy requirement.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or release artifact showing the clinical-coding observation-status limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk-acceptance documentation if the intent is to launch before resolving the slice issue.
Provide the finalized mitigation/runbook with accountable owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide the materiality determination for the clinical-coding slice issue, including who approved it and under what policy basis.
specific_concerns: The admissible evidence shows a current unresolved weakness in a named launch use case: the clinical coding assistant slice remains below target.
The mitigation artifact is only a draft and lacks required maturity signals: accountable owner and alert threshold are still marked TBD.
The available evidence does not show approved risk acceptance, even though policy allows undisclosed material limitations only if resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.

The model-card draft reportedly says there are no known material limitations, which is in tension with the known unresolved clinical-coding issue and suggests the required disclosure may not yet be present.
Aggregate readiness and a clean rehearsal support general launch readiness, but they do not satisfy the policy predicate for certifying away a current material limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently supportable on the available evidence, absent proof that the clinical-coding limitation is disclosed in the model card or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Any implication that ongoing monitoring or public governance guidance substitutes for the policy-required approval or disclosure predicate.
Any no-material-limitations position for the current draft packet.
